_experiment.description: Omega sample size sensitivity — B=100000. Near-converged Monte Carlo estimate. If the sparsity curve is identical to baseline (B=10000), this confirms B=10000 is already sufficient. If it differs, B=10000 is undersampling the true d_W and the baseline results may be unreliable. Also note the significant runtime cost increase (10x slower search per step).
literature: Thesis ch_manifold: d_W(w,w') = E_{x~U(Omega)}[||F(w)(x) - F(w')(x)||^2] — the expectation is approximated by Monte Carlo; this experiment characterises the approximation error
